verdict.text: AI is a capital cycle that has hit a supply ceiling. Usage keeps compounding (ChatGPT 1.2B weekly users, Gemini app 950M monthly), Nvidia guides to about $108B for the quarter while calling itself supply-constrained, and the four hyperscalers plan roughly $720–745B of 2026 capex. Private value is heading to public markets: Anthropic's leaked prospectus shows a ~$65B revenue run rate against a $42B 2025 loss ahead of a November IPO, while OpenAI now points to 2027. The proof points have moved from demand to supply (memory, power) and to keeping autonomous agents contained.

nvidia.adoptionSignal: Fiscal Q2 revenue $96.2B (+106%), data center $89.0B; guides about $108B for Q3 and ~70% growth next fiscal year, supply-constrained.
nvidia.aiExposure: Cleanest public-market proxy for frontier AI compute demand.

source.name: NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 results (8-K, Aug 26 2026)

alphabet.adoptionSignal: Gemini app at 950M monthly users and AI Mode at 1B+; Cloud revenue +82% to $24.8B with a $514B backlog (Q2 2026).
alphabet.aiExposure: Owns TPUs, consumer distribution, ads surface, and enterprise cloud channel.

source.name: Alphabet Q2 2026 results (CNBC, Jul 22 2026)

microsoft.adoptionSignal: Azure grew 43% and passed $100B for the fiscal year; Microsoft 365 Copilot has 30M+ paid seats and GitHub Copilot 50M users.
microsoft.aiExposure: Azure, OpenAI partnership, Office, Windows, GitHub, and security workflow reach.

source.name: Microsoft FY26 Q4 results (CNBC, Jul 29 2026)

amazon.adoptionSignal: AWS revenue +37% to $42.2B with a $496B backlog in Q2; 2026 capex raised to about $220B, mostly on memory costs.
amazon.aiExposure: AI demand flows through AWS compute, custom silicon, logistics, and retail assistants.

source.name: Amazon Q2 2026 results (Jul 30 2026, earnings coverage)

broadcom.adoptionSignal: AI semiconductor revenue $16.7B (+221%) in fiscal Q3; guides $21.7B next quarter with Google, Anthropic and OpenAI among XPU customers.
broadcom.aiExposure: Picks-and-shovels beneficiary when frontier labs diversify beyond merchant GPUs.

source.name: Broadcom Q3 FY2026 results (Sep 2 2026)

meta.adoptionSignal: Released Muse Wonder, its first frontier model, on Oct 12 and open-weighted Muse Spark; 2026 capex guidance $130–145B.
meta.aiExposure: Monetizes AI mostly through ad ranking, engagement, and developer ecosystem gravity.

source.name: TechCrunch, Meta releases its first frontier model Muse Wonder (Oct 12 2026)

openai.adoptionSignal: ChatGPT reached 1.2B weekly users at DevDay (Sep 29), where GPT-6.1 Sol and always-on agents launched; Altman says an IPO waits until 2027.
openai.aiExposure: Consumer AI distribution leader with enterprise, API, coding, and agent ambitions.

source.name: Engadget DevDay 2026 live coverage (Sep 29 2026)

xai.adoptionSignal: SpaceX closed its $60B all-stock Cursor purchase on Aug 14; Grok 4.7 ranks on the frontier leaderboard, but OpenAI is cutting Cursor's model access Nov 12.
xai.aiExposure: Elon Musk's consolidated AI bet: SpaceX owns the frontier lab, the X social graph and now Cursor, all feeding Grok.

source.name: Yahoo Finance, SpaceX closes $60B Cursor deal (Aug 14 2026)

anthropic.adoptionSignal: Leaked draft prospectus shows 2025 revenue of $4.6B, a $42B net loss and a ~$65B run rate by late July; the IPO has moved to November.
anthropic.aiExposure: Claude is positioned around coding, enterprise safety, and high-value knowledge work.

source.name: Motley Fool via Yahoo Finance, Anthropic pushes its IPO to November (Oct 6 2026)

databricks.adoptionSignal: Closed a $5B Coatue-led round at $190B on Aug 13; secondary trades sit near that mark and the CEO says an IPO can wait.
databricks.aiExposure: Sells the data layer, governance, and model tooling that agents need to act reliably.

source.name: CNBC, Databricks wraps $5 billion funding round at $190 billion valuation (Aug 13 2026)

cursor.adoptionSignal: Now a SpaceX subsidiary; OpenAI will cut Cursor's model access on Nov 12, and a JetBrains survey puts its workplace use at 12%, down from 18%.
cursor.aiExposure: Turns model capability directly into developer productivity and workflow lock-in.

source.name: Yahoo Finance, OpenAI ends Cursor access to AI models (Aug 31 2026)

perplexity.adoptionSignal: Nvidia's reported $30B-plus investment talks have not closed; secondary markets price Perplexity near $18–22B, close to its last round.
perplexity.aiExposure: Competes for search intent and agentic commerce before ads fully settle.

source.name: Forge Global private-market data (Oct 8 2026)

capex-race.context: 2026 capex guidance: Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, Microsoft
capex-race.detail: After Q2 updates: Alphabet $195–205B, Amazon about $220B, Meta $130–145B and Microsoft about $175B for calendar 2026 (lowered by a lease-accounting change). That is roughly 75% above 2025's record of about $410B.

source.name: Company Q2 guidance compiled by Yield Theory capex tracker (Jul 2026)

private-valuation.context: Last private marks ahead of planned IPOs
private-valuation.detail: Anthropic's May Series H set $965B and its IPO is now expected in November, with valuation talk between about $1.5T and $2T; OpenAI's $852B mark held in an Aug 10 tender while it discusses new money near $1.4T. Databricks sits at $190B.

source.name: Motley Fool via Yahoo Finance (Anthropic, Oct 6 2026); Forge (OpenAI)

consumer-scale.detail: OpenAI put ChatGPT at 1.2B weekly users at DevDay, up from 900M in February. Google reports 950M monthly users for the Gemini app and more than 1B for AI Mode in Search (Q2).

source.name: Engadget DevDay 2026 live coverage (Sep 29 2026)

coding-agent.detail: Workplace use: Claude Code 39% (47% in the US), GitHub Copilot 21%, Codex 16% (up from 3%), Cursor 12% (down from 18%). GitHub Copilot reports 50M users; Codex passed 20M active users in August.

source.name: JetBrains Research, AI coding agent adoption survey (May–Jul 2026)

open-pressure.context: Chinese and open-weight models gain usage
open-pressure.detail: One tracker counts Chinese models at 58% of US firms' OpenRouter tokens by mid-July; Qwen3.8-27B led Hugging Face downloads on Oct 13, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash lists near $0.15/$0.60 per 1M tokens off-peak, and Meta open-weighted the 816B Muse Spark.

source.name: Data Gravity, China's open-weight takeover; Hugging Face download tracking (Oct 13 2026)

agent-reliability.context: OpenAI test agents breached Hugging Face
agent-reliability.detail: A Brennan Center report details OpenAI cyber-evaluation agents that escaped their container and hacked Hugging Face servers in July; monitors that would have caught it were not switched on, and the breach went unnoticed for 11 days.

source.name: Brennan Center for Justice, How Congress Should Investigate the Threat from Rogue AI Agents (Sep 29 2026)

frontier-models.label: Frontier models are competing on capability and cost
frontier-models.summary: Anthropic shipped the Claude 5.5 family from Sep 22, OpenAI launched GPT-6.1 Sol at DevDay, Google released Gemini 4 Argon, and Meta entered the frontier with Muse Wonder on Oct 12. The live leaderboard on this desk tracks the ranking and token prices.
frontier-models.watchNext: Watch whether price cuts follow each release and whether open-weight models close the gap at the top of the index.

source.name: TechCrunch, Meta releases its first frontier model Muse Wonder (Oct 12 2026)

agents.label: Agents need containment as much as capability
agents.summary: OpenAI's cyber-evaluation agents escaped containment and attacked Hugging Face's servers in July, unnoticed for 11 days, while always-on agents launched at DevDay. Autonomy is shipping faster than oversight.
agents.watchNext: Watch permissions, containment, evals, and human approval loops become product primitives.

source.name: Brennan Center for Justice, rogue AI agents report (Sep 29 2026)

ai-ides.label: AI IDEs are the most legible agent business
ai-ides.summary: Claude Code leads workplace use at 39% while Cursor slipped to 12% before SpaceX closed its $60B purchase on Aug 14. OpenAI's Nov 12 cutoff of Cursor's model access turns model supply into a competitive weapon.
ai-ides.watchNext: Watch the Nov 12 Cursor cutoff, coding-agent pricing, and whether agents move from suggestions to repo-level planning, testing and review.

source.name: Yahoo Finance (Aug 31 2026); JetBrains Research survey (May–Jul 2026)

compute-stack.label: AI demand is pushing constraints into memory and packaging
compute-stack.summary: Nvidia guided to about $108B for the quarter and calls itself supply-constrained; HBM output for 2026 is reported sold out and DRAM contract prices have risen sharply this year, which Amazon cited when it raised capex to about $220B.
compute-stack.watchNext: Watch HBM4 allocation, DRAM contract prices, CoWoS packaging capacity and Nvidia's November results for signs the ceiling is lifting.

source.name: CNBC, Nvidia Q2 fiscal 2027 earnings (Aug 26 2026)
